assignmentTitle: Torque Requirement and Efficiency Estimation of a Bench Vice Screw Mechanism

criteria.title: Understand the Bench Vice Power-Screw Application
criteria.description: Understanding the engineering context: handle rotation converts to screw rotation, thread interaction drives axial movement of the movable jaw, and generates clamping force.

criteria.title: Identify Bench Vice Components and Mechanical Functions
criteria.description: Accurate identification of Fixed Jaw, Movable Jaw, Jaw Plate, Workpiece, Power Screw, Screw Head, Sliding Handle, Threaded Engagement, and Sliding Guide on Engineering Asset EA-18.

criteria.title: Understand Rotary-to-Linear Motion and Load Path
criteria.description: Correctly sequencing: Handle rotation → Power screw rotation → Thread interaction → Axial movement of movable jaw → Clamping force.

criteria.title: Establish Design Data for the Power-Screw Mechanism
criteria.description: Correctly identifying all given design parameters: W = 20,000 N, d = 24 mm, p = 5 mm, L = p = 5 mm (single-start), μ = 0.12, dc = 36 mm, μc = 0.10, R = 200 mm.

criteria.title: Determine Mean Diameter and Helix Angle
criteria.description: Correct application of dm = d − p/2 = 21.5 mm and tan α = L / (π dm) giving α ≈ 4.23° with appropriate units and working.

criteria.title: Calculate Thread Friction Torque
criteria.description: Correct computation of friction angle φ = atan(μ) and application of T_s = (W dm / 2) [(μ + tan α) / (1 − μ tan α)] in N·mm, showing all working steps.

criteria.title: Account for Collar Friction and Total Operating Torque
criteria.description: Correct calculation of T_c = μc W dc / 2 and total torque T = T_s + T_c in consistent units.

criteria.title: Calculate Efficiency, Self-Locking Condition and Operator Force
criteria.description: Correct calculation of η = [W L / (2π T)] × 100, correct self-locking check μ > tan α, and operator hand force F = T / R in SI units.

criteria.title: Engineering Judgement — Mechanism Suitability Assessment
criteria.description: Technically justified engineering recommendation addressing total torque, efficiency level, self-locking behavior, operator effort, and potential design improvements.

criteria.title: Bench Vice Power-Screw Analysis and Design Report
criteria.description: Concise engineering report covering all ten required items: mechanism purpose, mean diameter, helix angle, thread torque, collar torque, total torque, efficiency, self-locking conclusion, operator force, and engineering recommendation.
